announcements.headline: Interview with the Rt Hon Dominic Raab
announcements.insight: Reveille Resources PLC published an interview following its recent admission to the OTCID market. Shareholders should monitor for further updates on the proposed appointment of Lt General Rohling.

announcements.headline: Chairman Interview
announcements.insight: The Chairman Interview follows the October appointments of Mike Pompeo as Board Chairman and a new Lead Geologist. Shareholders should watch for strategic direction changes under this new leadership.
